metadata.question: Were the agricultural fields between the Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals in Ukraine browner on June 18, 2023 than on May 17, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to identify agricultural fields between Kakhovka Canal and North Crimean Canal in Ukraine - These are major irrigation canals in southern Ukraine (Kherson/Crimea region) - Compare two dates: May 17, 2023 vs June 18, 2023 - Use Sentinel-2 for high-resolution RGB/NIR data (10m resolution) - Dates are specific, so need small time windows around each date 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we're comparing vegetation/soil color - Use SCL band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Question asks about "browner" - this relates to vegetation health/senescence - Can use NDVI or brightness metrics to assess brownness 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: - Brown color = lower NDVI (vegetation stress/senescence) or higher red/NIR ratio - Valid result: NDVI values between -1 and 1 - Need to check if images exist for both dates - Need to ensure valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Compare the two periods: if June is browner (lower NDVI or different color metrics), answer A 4. Geographic considerations: - Kakhovka Canal runs from Kakhovka Reservoir - North Crimean Canal runs south toward Crimea - Area between them is around 46-47°N, 33-34°E in Kherson Oblast - This is a major agricultural region ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the region between Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals // This area is in southern Ukraine (Kherson Oblast) const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[33.3, 46.5], [34.2, 46.5], [34.2, 46.9], [33.3, 46.9], [33.3, 46.5]] ]); // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get May 2023 imagery const mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2023-05-14', '2023-05-20') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May images found: ${maySize}`); if (maySize === 0) { console.log("No images found for May 2023"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get June 2023 imagery const juneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2023-06-15', '2023-06-21') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const juneSize = juneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June images found: ${juneSize}`); if (juneSize === 0) { console.log("No images found for June 2023"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const mayImg = mayCol.median(); const juneImg = juneCol.median(); // Calculate NDVI for both periods (lower NDVI = browner/less vegetation) const mayNDVI = mayImg.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const juneNDVI = juneImg.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const mayStats = mayNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const juneStats = juneNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mayNDVIval = mayStats.NDVI_mean; const mayCount = mayStats.NDVI_count; const juneNDVIval = juneStats.NDVI_mean; const juneCount = juneStats.NDVI_count; console.log(`May NDVI: ${mayNDVIval?.toFixed(3)}, Valid pixels: ${mayCount}`); console.log(`June NDVI: ${juneNDVIval?.toFixed(3)}, Valid pixels: ${juneCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (!mayCount || mayCount === 0 || !juneCount || juneCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid values if (mayNDVIval === null || juneNDVIval === null || mayNDVIval === undefined || juneNDVIval === undefined || isNaN(mayNDVIval) || isNaN(juneNDVIval) || mayNDVIval > 1 || mayNDVIval < -1 || juneNDVIval > 1 || juneNDVIval < -1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI values calculated"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Browner = lower NDVI (less green vegetation, more bare soil/senescent crops) const ndviDiff = juneNDVIval - mayNDVIval; console.log(`NDVI difference (June - May): ${ndviDiff.toFixed(3)}`); if (juneNDVIval < mayNDVIval) { console.log("June fields are browner (lower NDVI) than May"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("June fields are NOT browner than May"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
